name: ONC-Benchmark
description:
This is a benchmark test set to detect marine mammal presence (humpback, orca, sea lion, pacific white sided dolphin) vs absence from two sites through Ocean Networks Canada. The labels, "mammal_present" represents the expert bioacoustician produced labels.
If you use this dataset, you must cite:
@misc{oceannetworkscanada2020,
  author = {{Ocean Networks Canada Society}},
  title = {Folger Deep Hydrophone Deployed 2020-03-08},
  year = {2020},
  publisher = {Ocean Networks Canada Society}… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/DORI-SRKW/ONC-Benchmark.
reputation: Provided by Ocean Networks Canada and used in marine bioacoustics research; respected within that domain but not widely used in general ML benchmark suites.
